what: The always-current internal site: a reusable generator, in its own repository and consumed as a versioned Action, that turns this repository's own records and GitHub issues into a milestone depth chart, a phone triage view, and the records themselves
position: Four milestones done, through Atlas v1.2.0. M1 built the generator; M2 adopted it here and put atlas.vennusign.com live behind an invited role; M2.1 rebuilt the feature planning page as drawn paths and made it reorderable; M3 shipped write-back as two managed Functions.
gate: Write-back is deployed but inert: the owner has to create and install the GitHub App, supply its credentials as Static Web App settings, and grant himself the `author` role. There is no UI to post from yet. #780 stays open with two defects found on first render — arrowheads overlapping the date text, and the phone view naming a next milestone that does not exist.
